title: Medicare Notice of Non-Coverage (NOMNC) - your covered services are ending

facts.action: If you disagree that your services should end, ask your QIO for an immediate (fast) appeal by phone; your services continue during the appeal. Sign the notice to show you received it.
facts.deadline: No later than noon on March 13, 2026: the day before coverage ends on March 14, 2026.
facts.consequence: Medicare probably won't pay for your skilled nursing services after March 14, 2026; you may have to pay for them yourself.

trap: 'Only if' letter. The deadline is 'noon of the day before the above date', so the reader has to work out the date.
